seeded_errors.description: The position feature control frame references datum C as its tertiary datum, but no datum feature symbol C appears on the drawing. Only datums A and B are defined.
Two datum feature symbols are both labelled A: one on the bottom edge and one on the top edge.
The flatness frame references datum A. Flatness is a form control and takes no datum.
The holes carry a position tolerance, but their locating dimensions (20, 80, 30) are plain dimensions, not basic ones.
The title block gives no general tolerance, and the overall height 60 prints no tolerance of its own.
Hole 3 (Ø6) has its centre 5 mm from the right edge, leaving a web far thinner than one hole diameter.
The position frame references datum D, but the drawing defines only A and B.
The flatness frame on the back face references datum A.
The Ø6 hole has its centre 5 mm from the right edge.
Datum B is placed twice: on the left edge and again on the right edge.
The hole position frame references datum C, but the drawing defines only A (the back face) and B (the bore).
The title block gives no general tolerance, and the collar diameter Ø40 prints no tolerance of its own.
The flatness frame on the bottom face references datum A. Flatness is a form control and takes no datum.
